newsitem.title: USA: Sinclair to buy Las Vegas' KUPN-TV.
newsitem.headline: Sinclair to buy Las Vegas' KUPN-TV.

text.p: Sinclair Broadcast Group Inc said it agreed to buy KUPN-TV in Las Vegas for $87 million.
The company also said it agreed to buy two Buffalo, New York-based radio stations -- WGR-AM and WWWS-AM -- for $1.5 million.
The acquisition -- an affiliate of UPN -- is expected to close in the third quarter, Sinclair said. The company will pay for it with debt, the issuance of securities, or both, it said.
Sinclair did not give specific financing details. Officials there were not immediately available.
After the KUPN-TV acquisition is completed, Sinclair said its television group will reach about 15 percent of U.S. television households.
